body.message:
No, ma’am. Let me explain why the rug is dirty.

As you saw, the balcony is extremely dusty and covered in black dirt. I even mentioned this in the previous messages. Every time we went onto the balcony and then came back inside, the bottoms of our feet became black because of the dirt outside. That is not our fault. You can simply ask your cleaning staff, and they will confirm the condition of the balcony.

Please return my security deposit. I did nothing wrong, and the apartment has been left clean. I had a feeling you might try to keep my deposit, which is exactly why I took and sent you photos of everything in advance to show the condition of the apartment before we left.
